profile.name: clearpath_husky_a200_published_reference
profile.source: Clearpath Husky A200 manual for dimensions. Analysis limits are conservative project assumptions, not measured or manufacturer-certified terrain capability.

notes: A200 base model, not Observer or A300; payload and mounting geometry are not included.
Ground clearance is not step-climbing capability.
The scalar 10-degree analysis limit is not a certified operating envelope.
The verified flag remains false because the complete operational profile was not field-tested.
